# watchpoint_user_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single user group by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_user_group" "example" {
  name = "Platform Team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the user group to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Group ID.
